changes.text: Styles ship in `dssoca/vanilla.css`, so the `.ss-image` markup can be used in plain HTML. The lightbox behaviour is not ported to `dssoca/vanilla.js`.

The skeleton shimmer token `--ss-image-shimmer` derives from the palette slot `--ss-bright-white` through `color-mix()` (6% in dark, 50% in light) instead of a hardcoded white `rgba()`, so it follows custom palettes.
The lightbox focus trap excludes disabled focusables and `tabindex="-1"` elements, so the backdrop no longer takes part in the Tab cycle.

New component: a responsive `<figure>` image with `<picture>` `sources` / `srcset`, an aspect-ratio box from `ratio` or `width`/`height` that prevents layout shift, lazy loading with an `eager` override, a loading skeleton, an error fallback, an optional `caption` and a built-in `lightbox` dialog (focus trap, `Esc` or backdrop click to close). It reads the new `--ss-image-*` tokens.
